description: Document model for the CampusKart marketplace. Business keys keep the original names from the MySQL design so exports, reports and the UI keep the same meaning.

design.references: One-to-many relationships use the original business keys (users.U_ID, item.Cat_ID, buy_request.I_ID). MongoDB indexes cover every foreign key used by a list or detail screen.
design.embedded: Small value lists and settings are independent documents because they are edited by admins and read by every page. Images and status history stay in their own collections to keep item documents small and auditable.
design.counters: A counters collection issues the human-readable ids (U104, I112, RQ110, CK-2026-0005) atomically with findOneAndUpdate.
design.validation: database/schemas/validators.js contains $jsonSchema rules for the core entities, applied by database/migrations/001-init.js.
design.transactions: The local development MongoDB can run as a standalone server. Critical sale/rental steps are written with ordered single-document updates and idempotent status guards; the README documents how to enable a replica set for multi-document transactions on Atlas.
